cohort: 60 neonates born at Rahbar Medical & Dental College Lahore and its attached hospital.
finding: Presence of nuchal cord at the time of delivery is associated with higher incidence of neonatal morbidity in terms of lower APGAR score, lower birth weight, and higher NICU admission rate.
gest_age: Not explicitly stated, but no significant difference in gestational age was found between groups.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was significantly lower in neonates with nuchal cord (3.01 kg) compared to those without (3.35 kg).
